title: 50 jaar Van Gogh Museum
excerpt: An LED wall for the museum's fiftieth birthday night, made with Skander Jaïbi and Cris Mollee from the collection's own digital files of the paintings.
description:
An evening marking the museum's fiftieth birthday, from 19:00 to 23:30, with music, dance, film and storytelling through the building.
Together with Skander Jaïbi and Cris Mollee I made the visuals for the large LED wall outside. We worked from the museum collection's own digital files of Vincent van Gogh's paintings and processed them in TouchDesigner, running them on the wall through the evening as the crowd gathered.
> Working from the museum's own scans means starting where the paintings already are: flat, lit evenly, measured. Putting them back outside at that scale gives them weather and a crowd again, which is closer to how they were made than how they are hung.
> The night was built around the same question as the wall: after fifty years, what does the next fifty look like, and what is a museum for.
credits: Visuals: Jaco Schilp, Skander Jaïbi and Cris Mollee. Built in TouchDesigner from the museum collection's digital files of Van Gogh's paintings, shown on a large LED wall. Part of the fiftieth birthday programme at the Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam, 2023, with Nnelg, Rens, Jaïr & Ome Uncle, ISH Dance Collectief, storytelling collective Mezrab, a film programme with Lab 111, and DJ sets by Fatima Ferrari, Donn Stone and DJ Dey.Rey.
